Elaine (PM): quick sync — stakeholder signals came in from Acme, Ops, and two pilots. we need to decide what stays in MVP vs v1.
Sam (Eng): ok what's the top ask?
Elaine (PM): Acme wants per-tenant rate limiting + audit logs. Ops wants SSO and region pinning. pilots care more about lower latency & small context windows.
Devon (ML): latency asks map to model choice and quantization; we can do a lightweight perf pass for a v1 config, but not MVP.
Maya (Design): UX for rate limiting could be a simple toggle + banner in console, not a full policy editor. low effort.
Sam (Eng): rough effort estimates: rate-limiting toggle ~3 dev days, audit logs ~6 days (storage+search), SSO ~8 days, region pinning ~5 days.
Elaine (PM): thanks. my proposal: MVP = console toggle for rate-limiting + banner, and a telemetry flag for audit logs (store minimal events), postpone full audit search to v1. SSO and region pinning -> v1.
Noah (CTO): agree with minimal audit capture for MVP. but define retention and PII gating now.
Elaine (PM): noted. Devon — can we do an interim perf band for pilots using current model + smaller context cap so pilots hit latency SLO?
Devon (ML): yes — suggest soft cap at 512 tokens with auto-truncate and model variant fallback to a faster quantized model. engineering impact minimal if we expose it as config.
Sam (Eng): implement fallback route + config flag. I can ship the route change in 4 days, add config in 1 day, tests in 2.
Maya (Design): I'll sketch the toggle + banner copy today. pinging @Sam for CSS/placement.
Elaine (PM): action items:
- Sam: implement rate limit toggle + fallback route (ETA 5 working days)
- Devon: provide model variant config + recommended soft cap (ETA 2 days)
- Maya: toggle/banner designs (ETA 1 day)
- Elaine: write stakeholder note and updated launch criteria (ETA EOD)

Product-bot: Created checklist: [ ] rate-toggle [ ] audit-telemetry [ ] model-fallback [ ] pilot-config [ ] design-banner

Sam (Eng): quick Q — if we ship audit telemetry as minimal events, what's the retention? Noah?
Noah (CTO): keep 30 days by default for MVP, redact user text fields, store only metadata (route, model, latency, status).
Elaine (PM): that meets compliance for pilots. we'll surface a data-retention setting in v1.
Devon (ML): flag: fallback model variant may have lower quality. we should add a regression check on prompt-set A to detect visible regressions.
Elaine (PM): good call. add to action list: regression check for pilot prompt-set A.
Sam (Eng): small note: region pinning for v1 — need infra changes (routing + metrics). I'll draft an infra ticket but not in MVP.
Maya (Design): banner copy draft: "Running in reduced-latency pilot mode: context capped at 512 tokens. See settings to change."
Elaine (PM): perfect. last thing — timeline: if we accept cuts, can we still make customer demo next Tues?
Sam (Eng): yes, with MVP scope we can demo rate toggle + latency fallback by Tues if we start now.
Elaine (PM): ok locking MVP scope as described. I'll send stakeholder note and updated milestone tracker.
Noah (CTO): thumbs up. keep me posted if any blockers.
Product-bot: Task update: rate-toggle assigned to Sam (ETA +5d). regression-check assigned to Devon (ETA +3d).
Sam (Eng): starting work now. will post progress updates in this thread.
Elaine (PM): thanks team — short daily check here until demo.
Sam (Eng): noted. :thumbsup:
